request.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: one ORIGINAL adult humanoid FRONT DESIGN REFERENCE for a project miniature; source-only proposal.
Primary request: Design an original adult female field reporter and ranged support companion. The internal project subject is April O'neil, companion of Michelangelo. Invent her face and clothing construction; no actor likeness, no reproduction of franchise key art or movie costumes.
Style/medium: richly detailed premium painted collectible miniature, polished sculptural anatomy, convincing cloth, leather, hair and metal with restrained surface wear, clear miniature-scale forms. The inspected Michelangelo owner reference informs ONLY sculptural finish, cohort consistency and warm ochre/olive palette, never turtle anatomy, identity, mask, shell, weapons or costume. The inspected Medusa quality reference informs ONLY sculptural detail and material readability, never its costume, anatomy, pose or camera/base perspective.
Scene/backdrop: perfectly plain uniform charcoal-gray background. One isolated figure on one round dark stone pedestal made from exactly TWO stacked shallow circular discs. The pedestal is viewed EXACTLY EDGE-ON: two straight horizontal front bands and a straight horizontal upper rim, ZERO visible top surface, no elliptical top plane. No floor, ground scene, scenery, contact pool or cast shadow on a floor.
Subject: clearly adult human woman in her early thirties, original face with composed alert expression, shoulder-length auburn hair entirely visible and swept off the face. Practical mustard-yellow short utility jacket ending at the high hip, open over a simple cream crew-neck top, dark olive practical trousers, brown ankle boots. Tasteful functional seams and unbranded pockets; no logos or printed badges. No headgear, jewelry, weapons or extra equipment.
Pose and hands: strict straight FRONT orthographic reference. Face, nose, shoulders, torso, hips, knees and feet face directly at the viewer without yaw or three-quarter twist. Feet comfortably apart, both standing on the base. Relaxed arms with gently bent elbows, hanging away from torso; clear charcoal-background gaps around both elbows/forearms, and between legs. Her OWN RIGHT hand (VIEWER'S LEFT) holds a SMALL handheld camcorder lowered beside the outside of her right thigh; its wrist/hand and visible gripping fingers remain readable, no obstruction by her jacket or hip. Camcorder is compact and unbranded with no strap or dangling cords. Her OWN LEFT hand (VIEWER'S RIGHT) hangs open with palm facing forward, one distinct thumb and four separate gently relaxed visible fingers; separated from her trouser leg. Natural believable hands and wrists.
Composition/framing: portrait 2:3 canvas, exactly one centered complete full figure and pedestal. Straight FRONT ORTHOGRAPHIC camera at the figure's mid-height, no perspective distortion, no camera tilt and no view from above. Highest hair point at approximately 6% of image height, entire head/hair and all fingertips inside canvas, at least 6% side margins. Bottom edge of the complete pedestal at exactly 90% of image height, leaving 10% plain charcoal below it. Both pedestal discs and both boots fully in frame.
Lighting/mood: neutral balanced soft studio light with readable materials and gentle dimensional shading, no cinematic effects.
Text: none.
Constraints: one adult human only; fully visible natural human hands; right-hand lowered camcorder and left-hand open; relaxed bent arms; strict front orthographic; exactly two edge-on base discs with no visible top; charcoal background.
Avoid: child/teen appearance, celebrity likeness, turtle traits, owner costume, copied movie jumpsuit, Medusa traits, action pose, foreshortening, three-quarter views, exposed pedestal top, cropped head/feet/hands, third base tier, floating props, extra limbs or fingers, fused fingers, VFX, aura, sparks, smoke, graphic overlays, text, numbers, UI, logos, watermark.

Edit target: the attached original adult female reporter miniature front reference.
Make ONLY these concrete framing and hand corrections; preserve the same original adult woman's facial identity, auburn hairstyle, mustard-yellow jacket, cream top, dark olive trousers, ankle boots, compact unbranded camcorder in her OWN RIGHT hand (VIEWER'S LEFT), detailed sculptural materials, and charcoal background. No costume redesign or extra elements.

1. FRAMING: keep a 1024 x 1536 portrait composition. Reframe the ENTIRE figure and pedestal proportionally so the highest hair pixel begins at approximately y=92 (6% of image height), and the bottom edge of the complete pedestal is y=1382 (90%), with plain charcoal from y=1383 down. The entire head, both hands, camcorder, boots and pedestal remain visible. Straight FRONT orthographic, symmetrical frontal shoulders/hips/knees, camera level with mid-torso, no looking down.

Rotate that palm forward, gently open it beside her thigh with FIVE anatomically plausible digits: one distinct thumb and four separate relaxed fingers with visible charcoal gaps between them, all tips visible. Do not make a salute; arm stays lowered and elbow softly bent. Keep the clear elbow/forearm-to-body gap. Preserve the right hand lowered camcorder grip and make the visible thumb and gripping fingers anatomically clear.
3. PEDESTAL FRAMING: retain exactly TWO shallow round dark stone discs, but show them EXACTLY EDGE-ON as two straight horizontal front bands, horizontal straight rims, and NO visible upper/top surface at all. Boots contact the straight upper rim. No third tier, no oval top plane, no floor, no scenery.

Do not add text, logos, UI, VFX, shadows on a floor, additional props, extra limbs, celebrity likeness or copied franchise details. Preserve the same calm expression and original reporter identity. One centered complete adult humanoid source reference only.
